capabilities: chat with an OpenAI-compatible model about vault notes in a sidebar
search notes locally without cloud indexing or embeddings
pin notes as chat context via Add note, Add open note, or wikilinks
propose new, updated, or moved notes that are written only after Apply
connect to OpenAI, OpenRouter, or Ollama providers with a user-supplied key or URL
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+. Detailed privacy section; the wikilink context picker does not work on mobile and localhost Ollama is usually unreachable from a phone.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with an AI model about vault content while keeping search local and controlling what is sent to the provider.
